text: Binary (1/0/null) from the conversation column only (turns formatted '[speaker]: message', separated by blank lines): 1 if it contains a multi-turn reply interaction, i.e. a back-and-forth of at least three consecutive turns where a speaker label returns after at least one other speaker's intervening turn (e.g. A, B, A), with the later turn plausibly replying within the exchange. 0 if only single turns, only distinct speakers with no returning speaker, or only one-off comments. Bracketed text inside a message body is not a turn label unless it starts a new turn in the format; do not infer who the OP is. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; turns consisting solely of such content don't count as interaction turns, though generic discussion of delta/platform rules counts normally, and content isn't counted merely for being an announcement. Null if conversation is missing, empty, or malformed so turns can't be identified.
